/.title: Settsmartly – Household Finance App for Flatmates in India
/.description: Settsmartly helps flatmates and working professionals in India manage rent, bills, groceries and settlements in one place, with an AI voice assistant.

/features.title: Features – Settsmartly
/features.description: AI voice assistant, household workspace, smart splitting, recurring bills, roommate move-in and move-out, UPI settlements and insights for flatmates.

/voice-assistant.title: AI Voice Assistant – Settsmartly
/voice-assistant.description: Add household expenses by speaking in English, Hindi or Hinglish. The assistant prepares a draft, our engine does the maths, and nothing saves until you confirm.

/flatmates.title: For Flatmates – Settsmartly
/flatmates.description: Built for flatmates sharing a rented flat: rent, utilities, groceries, move-ins and move-outs, and monthly settlements in one place. Beta starting in Bengaluru.

/how-it-works.title: How It Works – Settsmartly
/how-it-works.description: Set up your household, invite flatmates, add expenses by voice or by hand, put bills on autopilot and settle up every month with Settsmartly.

/pricing.title: Pricing – Settsmartly
/pricing.description: Settsmartly will be free for every flat's core expense management, with optional Plus, Premium and Household plans for AI and advanced household features.

/about.title: About Us – Settsmartly
/about.description: Settsmartly is building India's household financial management platform for people who live together, starting with flatmates in Bengaluru.

/contact.title: Contact Us – Settsmartly
/contact.description: Get in touch with the Settsmartly team about the beta, product feedback, partnerships, press or business enquiries. A real person will reply.

/get-started.title: Join the Waitlist – Settsmartly
/get-started.description: Join the Settsmartly waitlist for early access to household financial management for flatmates. Closed beta starting in Bengaluru.

/login.title: Log In – Settsmartly
/login.description: The Settsmartly app isn't open yet. Join the waitlist and we'll email you as soon as you can create your account.

/careers.title: Careers – Settsmartly
/careers.description: Help build household financial management for people who live together in India. No open roles right now, but we'd love to hear from you.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy – Settsmartly
/privacy.description: How Settsmartly collects, uses and protects the information you share through settsmartly.com, and the rights you have over it.

/terms.title: Terms and Conditions – Settsmartly
/terms.description: The terms that govern your use of the Settsmartly website, including the waitlist, acceptable use and the fact that we are not a bank or payment service.

/refunds.title: Refund Policy – Settsmartly
/refunds.description: Settsmartly does not sell paid plans yet. Refund and cancellation terms will be published here before any plan goes on sale.
